name: Washington
eyebrow: PSE · Seattle City Light · Avista · Tacoma Power · Clark Public Utilities
short: Washington has no single statewide rebate, so the money depends on your utility. Clark Public Utilities pays $1,500 for a heat pump water heater, Puget Sound Energy pays $1,500 for most heat pump upgrades and $1,000 for a water heater, and Tacoma Power pays up to $2,000 for a heat pump with 0 percent loans. Avista pays $1.75 per square foot for thin insulation. Seattle City Light gives a $300 to $600 contractor discount and the City pays $2,000 to leave oil heat. Solar equipment is exempt from sales tax through 2029, the federal credits ended after 2025, and the state's federal-funded rebates have not launched.
